title: One Public Mandate Is Not A Multi-Authority Compact
summary: A dependency path from one bounded public mandate through jurisdiction, treaty, standing, externality, party authorization, joint terms, and receipts.
map_question: What records are required before one public mandate is not a multi-authority compact can move from assertion to a bounded public decision?
interpretation_boundary: This map is a control path. It does not establish a mandate, jurisdiction, compact, contribution, mutual-aid activation, emergency, rights restriction, normalization, receipt, score, rank, or outcome.

nodes.label: Jurisdiction, treaty, rights, duty, and standing map
nodes.note: Authority and affected-public identities remain separate.

nodes.label: Cross-boundary benefit, burden, risk, and residual-duty record
nodes.note: Flows are traced across the full system.

nodes.label: Joint purpose, alternatives, allocation, contribution, and governance terms
Continuity, dispute, emergency, rights, and remedy controls
nodes.note: Operating readiness does not expand authority.

nodes.label: Expiry, restoration, accounting, and democratic reauthorization
nodes.note: Extraordinary action must return to ordinary authority.

nodes.label: Independent review, dissent, public notice, archive, and receipts

links.note: One public mandate cannot assign every authority.
Scope and duty determine which flows must be tested.
Allocation needs explicit benefit and burden evidence.
Operating duties must be authorized and safeguarded.
Activation requires a bounded exit and restoration path.
Every change and closure needs an inspectable decision receipt.

what_this_map_supports: Separate authority, public-value, contribution, continuity, emergency, and normalization decisions.
Explicit rights, treaty, accessibility, distribution, dispute, remedy, expiry, and residual-duty controls.
Public receipts without composite scoring or jurisdictional ranking.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish a current compact, emergency, benefit, burden, contribution, dispute, or reauthorization.
It does not permit silent renewal, authority laundering, contribution-as-control, or automatic rights suspension.
It does not create a score, rank, stage advance, or operating-outcome change.
next_records_needed: A real, authorized, time-bounded Phase 77 mandate and receipt.
Completed authority, standing, treaty, externality, public-value, burden, contribution, and dispute records.
Separately authorized compact, activation, normalization, and reauthorization decisions with receipts.
